description.zh:
安全组描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空，不会进行修改。
description.en:
The description of the security group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: null. The description is not modified.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
安全组名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文等）和数字。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

默认值：空，不会进行修改。
description.en:
The name of the security group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain characters that are categorized as letters in Unicode, including Chinese characters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

Default value: null. The name is not modified.

title.zh: 修改安全组的名称或者描述
title.en: Modify the name or description of a security group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-security-group-attribute --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --description TestDescription --security-group-name SecurityGroupTestName --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifySecurityGroupAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description TestDescription --SecurityGroupName SecurityGroupTestName --SecurityGroupId 'sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
